subject: Pilot window: temporary API token & sprint padding request
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@kiteworks.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Liu <ben.liu@kiteworks.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot window: temporary API token & sprint padding request

Hi Soojin,

Quick update from our engineering team — during yesterday's full-stack validation we hit two blockers integrating Redwood's connector with our event router: one is an auth flow mismatch (SAML assertion expiry during long-running QA jobs) and the other is an intermittent webhook timeout when replaying historical events.

Given the timing of our demo (next Friday) the team is asking for two things so we don't lose the momentum: 1) a short pilot extension (14 days) on our sandbox so we can finish the replay jobs, and 2) a temporary API token with a 7-day expiry so QA can bypass the SAML gate while we patch the environment.

I've attached the integration logs and a short infra note from our eng lead. We're committed to shipping the demo but this stretch would buy us enough time to get a clean run.

Can Redwood approve a two-week pilot extension and issue a scoped token limited to event replay endpoints? If there are guardrails you need us to accept (IP allowlist, strict token TTL, or usage caps), we can sign off quickly.

Appreciate any help — thanks.

Best,
Maya Patel
Senior Platform Engineer, KiteWorks
[Attachment: integration-log-snippet.pdf (3 pages)]
[Attachment: kiteworks_infra-overview.pdf (1 page)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Ben Liu <ben.liu@kiteworks.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot window: temporary API token & sprint padding request

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear notes and the logs. Sorry to hear QA ran into that replay/auth gap.

Short answer: we can typically accommodate a short sandbox extension and issue limited tokens, but I need quick approval from our risk/ops lead for the token guardrails. Karthik / Marissa — looping you both in for the operational sign-off: Maya is requesting a 14-day pilot extension and a single-use scoped API token (replay-only) with a 7-day TTL. They are willing to accept an IP allowlist and a hard usage cap.

Maya — if you confirm the IP ranges and the exact endpoints you need (e.g., /v1/events/replay), I will initiate the review and propose the token config. If approved, we'll provide a token stub and add monitoring/audit hooks.

Thanks — Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

On Sep 19, 2026, at 08:23 AM, Maya Patel <maya@kiteworks.com> wrote:
> Quick update from our engineering team — during yesterday's full-stack validation we hit two blockers integrating Redwood's connector with our event router...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot window: temporary API token & sprint padding request

Soojin / Marissa — reviewed the logs Maya attached. The issues look like replay scale and an auth TTL edge case; both are low to medium risk provided we apply constraints. Approve the following:

- Pilot extension: +14 days to sandbox (no change to billing).
- Temporary token: single token scoped only to /v1/events/replay and related read endpoints; TTL 7 days; rate cap 100 req/min; IP allowlist to the ranges Maya provides.
- Audit: enable request-level logging and create a short-lived internal ticket to look for abnormal spike patterns.

Marissa, please prepare the token with the above constraints and ensure it is tagged in our audit logs. Soojin, once token is ready share the outbound instructions and any acceptance steps KiteWorks must sign off on.

Karthik
Head of Reliability Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sso-error-dump.txt (excerpt)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Ben Liu <ben.liu@kiteworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T16:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot window: temporary API token & sprint padding request

Hi Maya — good news. We've approved the request and created a scoped token per Karthik's guardrails. Summary below: 

1) Pilot extension: sandbox access extended +14 days from today (new expiry 2026-10-06).
2) Temporary API token: token id redacted for email; scope limited to /v1/events/replay and /v1/events/status. TTL 7 days (expires 2026-09-29 23:59:59 UTC). Rate cap: 100 req/min.
3) IP allowlist: please confirm the CIDR ranges you want added (we will add those before token activation).
4) Audit & monitoring: we've enabled request-level logging for the token and created internal ticket RD-12892 to watch for anomalies.

Attached are the token usage instructions and a small checklist for acceptance tests. Once you confirm the IP ranges we'll flip the token from pending to active and email the exact token string via a one-time secure link (DocuSign-style delivery).

Next steps for KiteWorks:
- Reply with the IP ranges and confirm you accept the rate cap.
- Run the replay job and paste one successful event ID back here for our logs.

If you prefer, we can also schedule a 30-min troubleshooting call with our integration engineer (Marissa) tomorrow.

Thanks — glad we could keep the demo window intact.

Sincerely,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Attachments: token-activation-instructions.pdf, token-acceptance-checklist.txt
